title: How Do Submarines Dive And Surface? 🚢
description: Ever wonder how massive metal submarines dive deep into the ocean and float right back up with total ease? Discover the mind-blowing physics behind it.

scenes.say: How does this massive metal structure dive deep into the ocean and return to the surface with total ease?
Submarines rely on a simple physics principle, controlling their weight and volume relative to the surrounding water.

scenes.title: How it dives
scenes.say: When the submarine wants to go down, special valves open to let water into internal tanks, increasing its weight to dive.
To surface, compressed air is pumped in forcefully to push the water out of the tanks, making it lighter so it floats instantly.
Did you know? The submarine system is entirely inspired by the swim bladder in fish, which controls their depth.
In short, filling the tanks with water makes it dive, and filling them with air makes it float to the surface.
